ev.q: one to four (sometimes up to six) players work together
a mix of tower defense, role-playing, and action-adventure
by either magically creating, maintaining, and upgrading towers
As the character levels up with experience, the player can allocate points
Eight out of the twelve total classes have a unique set of defenses and a specific set of weapons
collected from killing monsters, opening chests, or beating the level
The game takes place in a fantasy setting
hardcore mode, which improves rewards, but prevents players from respawning during combat
Characters are selected from the available character classes
